title: Policy intake refactor: schema-first routing ingestion and staged acceptance
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Replace the brittle ad-hoc policy ingestion path with a schema-first validator and staged acceptance pipeline. This ticket drives a refactor of the policy intake component so submitted routing DSL/configs go through a multi-stage check: syntax -> typed schema -> semantics (region/tier compatibility) -> safety heuristics -> gradual activation.

Motivation: Current runtime accepts many legacy configurations that cause surprising fallbacks and regional weight skew. We're seeing late-stage rollouts fail because invalid constraints only surface at dispatch time. A schema-first intake will catch class-I errors earlier, provide actionable diagnostics to customers/console, and enable automated migration hints for deprecated constructs.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement the full policy transpiler or rollout execution engine. It focuses on the intake/validation surface, diagnostics, and a staged activation flagging mechanism.

Acceptance criteria:
- New validator library (Go) that ingests DSL JSON/YAML and returns typed errors with actionable hints.
- A staged acceptance flow: "accepted-queued" -> "accepted-strong" -> "active" based on rule vetting and CI checks.
- Console shows validation hints and migration suggestions for deprecated fields.
- Backcompat shim: incoming legacy keys are mapped with warnings, not failures, unless safety checks fail.
- Unit test coverage for 95% of the validator cases and an integration test that rejects an invalid regional affinity rule at intake.

Rollout plan: ship validator behind a feature flag (policy_intake_v2). Enable for 5% of orgs, monitor validation rejection rate and false-positive alerts (console-telemetry tag: policy.validator.v2). If stable, increase to 50% then full rollout.

Notes on interfaces: The validator exposes a single REST endpoint for the Console and a grpc API for the private control plane. Error payloads must include an error_code, human_message, and optional migration_hint field to drive console UI guidance.
updates: 2026-01-20: Spike complete. PoC validator prototype in Go validates simple region/tier enums and returns structured errors. PoC at https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/tree/feature/policy-intake-proto

2026-01-28: Design review with PM and Console done. Decision: keep typed schema (protobuf) as canonical representation with generated Go/TS bindings. Trade-off: protobuf adds one compilation step but gives cross-language safety.

2026-02-03: Trade-off discussion: strict vs lenient mode. We will default to lenient (warn) for deprecated legacy keys and strict for newly introduced safety checks (e.g., cross-region negative weights). Rationale: minimize customer interruption during rollout.
2026-02-10: Initial API prototype merged to branch feature/policy-intake-v2. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 (WIP). Unit harness and fuzzer hooks included.

2026-02-18: Performance profiling: validator average CPU < 2ms for typical rule payload (1-5kb) on x86 c5.large; worst-case pathological inputs (large nested conditionals) spike to ~18ms. Plan: add fast-path parser and streaming validation for large payloads in next sprint.

2026-02-25: Security review kickoff completed. Identified requirements for KMS access when validator fetches model-variant metadata. Security action: limit network calls from validator and cache metadata in control plane. (security ticket created).
comments: Marco Chen (assignee) 2026-01-22: Implemented protobuf schema and generator. Pushed initial types to internal repo under proto/policy. Please review field names; avoided snake_case to match existing infra conventions.

Lina Garcia (PM) 2026-01-29: Console needs migration_hint to render one-click transformation suggestions. Added mockups to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUNTIME/Policy+Intake+V2+UI

Infra review (2026-02-11): flagged potential N+1 lookups when validator resolves regional tiers. Action: batch metadata resolves and use a short LRU cache. See RFC: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/2026/08-policy-intake-cache.md

Code review (2026-02-16): PR 4321 needs clearer error codes (use POLY_ prefix). @sanity/tests failing on two edge cases: nested fallback where variant aliases are used. Added follow-up testcases in tests/validator/edge_fallbacks.go

QA 2026-02-22: Integration harness scenarios added: (1) legacy-key migration, (2) disallowed cross-region weight > 0.75, (3) tier-not-present rejection. Passing on staging for (1) and (3); intermittent failure on (2) due to rounding differences — investigating.
Design feedback 2026-02-26: Suggest adding a soft-warning level that surfaces in Console without blocking. This will help customers migrate away from deprecated constructs more smoothly.
